info.name: ship-app
info.description: Functional API QA for ShipTest. Run in folder order using ShipTest Local against a disposable local database. A unique QA account is created each run and remains in the database. Shipment cleanup targets IDs created in that run. Assistant checks use the health result to select the expected response. Keep Postman cookies enabled. Authentication chain: clear session → register → verify registration session → clear it and verify 401 → log in → verify login session → run shipment and assistant requests → log out → verify 401. The Postman cookie jar handles auth_session, an HttpOnly JWT. No bearer token or token variable is required. Run Rates before Shipments so finalization can compare its total with the quote.
